methods.actual_product: Optional evidence review displays compared inputs without filtering existing findings or adding any fusion/confidence contribution. The study compares hypothetical evidence selections only.
methods.baseline: Previous exact 3-sentence current score >=0.5, first 6 qualifying source-ordered foci; compare .85, strict and pooled as unchanged secondary references.
methods.eligible: Use unchanged generator families, seeds, ordinary-control scope, complete EOS and copy/format/word gates. Explain missed, false and unassessed cases explicitly.
methods.isolated: Add exactly the existing optional production paragraph-only scoring helper with same checkpoint, configured CPU classifier, first two admitted interior paragraphs and complete <=512-token single-window coverage. A current plus isolated raw response >=0.5 is required on the same paragraph; rank by current, tie to earlier source. The two measurements share weights.
methods.metric: Non-whitespace IoU >= 0.30 to known generated paragraph; human-file and source-group flags, retained and lost useful locations, exact contextual scores and input commitments. Break out two genres and two generator families.
methods.question: Prospectively test the already chosen isolated-paragraph rule on independent genres: court majority opinions and prepared agency speeches. No parameter selection or fit.
methods.scope_only: Select the single highest-scoring eligible interior paragraph containing a current focus >=0.5, tie to earlier source. This isolates a smaller display extent from the added inference.

scope: Independent local transfer of evidence-only paragraph comparison with unchanged scoring.

policy.case: Four source-ordered eligible body blocks. Choose a 45–110-word interior target and source-only whole-paragraph and one-sentence donor replacements of similar length. Freeze all exact Unicode intervals, source bytes and control files before generation.
policy.projection: Use native PDF text, page/block coordinates and normalized whitespace for attributed majority prose, and agency HTML paragraph text for speeches. Syllabus, dissent, long quotations, headings, references and outside material are excluded. Some typesetting artifacts may remain in PDF text.
policy.roster: Take four qualifying 2021 source works with distinct official authors per genre in the fixed roster order. Original language is English. Majority opinions only and official prepared speeches only. Source family includes U.S. Supreme Court and Federal Reserve Board.
policy.separation: Check normalized exact 12-token overlap with known retained project sources and within the confirmation panel; model-pretraining exposure is unknown.
